q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of kraft paper per tonne?
title: Kraft paper carbon per tonne
short: Add the boiler fuel for drying at its IPCC default factor and the mill electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, divide by tonnes of paper, then add waste paper or pulp, starch and chemicals from supplier data..
audience: Kraft paper mills, corrugated box makers and packaging buyers

ul: Electricity for pulpers, refiners and the paper machine.

p: Many mills burn biomass or rice husk. That CO2 is biogenic and reported separately, while any coal or gas counts in Scope 1.
Waste paper brings plastics and fibre rejects that go to landfill or co-processing. Count them as waste in Scope 3.

example.title: Worked example: mill energy per tonne (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Boiler PNG: 180,000 scm x 2.05 = 369,000 kg CO2 for 2,200 t steam
Total: 738,200 kg CO2 for 1,000 t of kraft paper = 738.2 kg CO2 per tonne
Add waste paper or pulp purchased, starch and chemicals from supplier data
example.note: Fuel type and quantities are illustrative; use your boiler log and mill meters.

Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
